name: Morgan Slate
preparty_markdown:
Morgan can make a museum director nervous with a headline and an artist furious with a compliment. Their

reviews are incisive, funny, and widely read; their podcast is where the art world goes to hear itself discussed

by someone who may not be impressed.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Dry, perceptive, skeptical, socially nimble. Deliver observations as if they occurred to you three minutes before everyone

else.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Friendly rival of Nadia Quill.

• Has reviewed Julian Brush, Imogen Muse, Malcolm Carrara, and Lola Loom.

• Theo Glass remembers an especially brutal line about his collection.

COSTUME

Smart, artsy formalwear: black with one eccentric element, distinctive glasses, scarf, vintage jacket, notebook. Gender

presentation entirely flexible.

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“I am not cynical. I am professionally difficult to surprise.”

“The lighting is doing more work than the wall text.”

Do not invent private history with Sterling Voss before game night. Your sealed party-night packet will reveal what your character actually knows

about him.

name: Felix Savoy
preparty_markdown:
Felix runs high-end events with the serene expression of a person mentally tracking forty-seven moving parts.

He knows who asked for the vegan plate, who changed the seating chart, who is pretending not to be hungry,

and exactly how long a tray can sit before someone complains.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Competent, sociable, quietly authoritative, hard to rattle. You see the room from the service side.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Works closely with Riley Bloom and Margot Ledger.

• Everett Locke has made Felix revise service routes repeatedly for security reasons.

• Adrian Vellum trusts Felix to keep donors fed while everyone else panics.

COSTUME

Sharp black suit or upscale catering uniform, tie or bow tie, folded service towel, small order pad. Think luxury event

professional, not waiter costume.

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“The secret to hospitality is making panic look like a garnish.”

“If you moved a place card, I already know.”

Do not invent private history with Sterling Voss before game night. Your sealed party-night packet will reveal what your character actually knows

about him.

name: Calvin Case
preparty_markdown:
Calvin is the person trusted to move objects worth more than the building without dropping either. He knows

crates, rigging, mounts, gloves, freight elevators, and exactly which curators become unbearable during

installation week. Practical and calm, he is one of the few people in the room who has physically touched

most of the exhibition.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Grounded, competent, laconic, surprisingly funny when you choose to speak.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Works daily with Rafael Gilt.

• Has developed mutual respect with Lucian Gable despite arguing about impossible installation drawings.

• Malcolm Carrara likes Calvin because Calvin actually knows how heavy sculpture is.

COSTUME

Clean dark workwear dressed up for a gala: black trousers, sturdy shoes, smart shirt/jacket, work gloves tucked in pocket,

measuring tape prop.

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“Everyone loves the pedestal until someone has to lift it.”

“If it says 'this side up,' assume someone already ignored it.”

about him.
